integrity: The theorem is derived directly from the published generator and baseline formulas. The heavy-tail criterion is taken from the primary Type-I heavy-tailed-G source. Finite numerical checks are supplementary and are not used to infer the asymptotic result.
scientific_limitations: The universal result is a first-order logarithmic tail equivalent, not a multiplicative equivalent for the survival itself.
At the critical Burr XII phase the exponential rate is identified, but the moment-generating function at the single boundary point t=lambda is not classified.
Asymptotic tail class does not determine finite-sample goodness of fit or finite-level actuarial risk rankings.
title: Universal tail law for HT-WF-G and the sharp Burr XII heavy-tail phase
